verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing exposes a comprehensive documented REST API (create cards/cardholders, webhooks, spending controls, disputes, funding) confirmed by both first-party docs and community users who call it an 'API-first product,' plus machine-readable docs (llms.txt, issuing.md) verified by probes. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s at standard OpenAPI endpoints).
